select (select code from gl_chart_of_account where length(code) <= 10 and code like '41%' order by code limit 1) as inc_code,
(select name_1 from gl_chart_of_account where length(code) <= 10 and code like '41%' order by code limit 1) as inc_name,
(select code from gl_chart_of_account where length(code) <= 10 and code like '113%' order by code limit 1) as itm_code,
(select name_1 from gl_chart_of_account where length(code) <= 10 and code like '113%' order by code limit 1) as itm_name,
(select code from gl_chart_of_account where length(code) <= 10 and code like '51%' order by code limit 1) as cst_code,
(select name_1 from gl_chart_of_account where length(code) <= 10 and code like '51%' order by code limit 1) as cst_name,
(select code from gl_chart_of_account where length(code) <= 10 and code like '42%' order by code limit 1) as alt_code,
